selection_criterion: 5-Fold Train CV ROC-AUC with 1-SE parsimony rule: PyTorch MLP (0.9117 ± 0.0086, SE=0.0038) vs. XGBoost (0.9100 ± 0.0092) differed by 0.0017 (< 1 SE). Selected XGBoost as deployed model for torch-free API serving and exact TreeSHAP; PyTorch MLP is retained as a deep-learning comparison baseline.
threshold_tuning_method: Unified rule across all models: thresholds are tuned strictly on Out-of-Fold (OOF) calibrated probability predictions on the 80% training split (cross_val_predict with CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid')). Primary 'screening' threshold targets 80% OOF training sensitivity; secondary 'confirmatory' threshold targets >=92% OOF training specificity.

clinical_error_analysis_note: Deployed model (XGBoost): Screening mode misses 23.8% of IPF cases (36 of 151 missed on the untouched test set), and confirmatory mode misses 39.1% of IPF cases (59 of 151). In screening mode, i-NSIP (60.9% flagged), u-ILD (31.1% flagged), and CTD (35.0% flagged) are most often misclassified as IPF, which is clinically expected. Overlap between IPF and fibrotic i-NSIP, u-ILD, and CTD is expected clinically because these interstitial lung diseases share restrictive mechanics and reduced TLCO; this system is decision support only and never replaces multidisciplinary diagnosis.

feature_set_ablation.summary_note: On the real Zenodo ILD training set, 'both' (0.9055 ± 0.0123), 'pp_only' (0.9040 ± 0.0108), and 'z_only' (0.9051 ± 0.0117) perform within one standard error. 'pp_only' is deployed for /predict-ipf because clinical spirometry reports directly provide % predicted values.

imbalance_comparison.rationale: Class weights (0.9021 ± 0.0091) vs. in-fold SMOTE (0.8989 ± 0.0078): cost-sensitive class weighting achieves higher CV ROC-AUC while preserving the true physiological feature distribution prior to probability calibration.

calibration_curve.methodology_note: CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=5) was fit on the training split (also used for tuning); Brier scores and calibration curve coordinates are evaluated strictly on the untouched 20% test set.

osic_progression_study.study_note: Progression results are exploratory, separate cohort, no IPF labels. Evaluated via 5-Repeat × 5-Fold Nested GroupKFold by Patient (min_visits>=3). Variant 1 (~52-week FVC change, n=176): Baseline RMSE = 269.8 mL vs. XGBoost RMSE = 268.3 mL (AUC = 0.616). Variant 2 (Robust Theil-Sen slope, n=176): Baseline RMSE = 4.990 mL/wk vs. XGBoost RMSE = 4.864 mL/wk (AUC = 0.610). imaging_model_available=True (175/176 patients have cached 3D CT features). Neither Clinical + HU/Volume nor Clinical + ResNet-18 (In-Fold PCA 15D) clearly beat Clinical-only with non-overlapping 95% CIs; progression modeling remains strictly exploratory.

osic_competition_benchmark.metric_definition: Modified Laplace Log-Likelihood: sigma clipped >= 70 mL, |FVC_true - FVC_pred| clipped <= 1000 mL
osic_competition_benchmark.image_tabular_design: Image + Tabular predicts change from Baseline_FVC (Delta_FVC = Target_FVC - Baseline_FVC) using in-fold 1st-99th percentile winsorization on HU/volume features, in-fold 15D ResNet-18 PCA, and strong L2 regularization (Ridge alpha in [100, 500, 1000]), reconstructed as Baseline_FVC + Delta_FVC and winsorized to [500, 6500] mL.
osic_competition_benchmark.efficientnet_b5_note: EfficientNet-B5 end-to-end 3D fine-tuning was NOT run locally because the 10.4 GB raw OSIC DICOM archive is excluded from the handover package and Kaggle GPU extraction used pretrained ResNet-18 (512-D) embeddings.

fusion_comparison.split_strategy: 5-Repeat x 5-Fold Nested GroupKFold by Patient (exact same 25 folds for all 6 methods; PCA, scalers, winsorizers, weights, and meta-learners fit strictly inside training folds)
fusion_comparison.paired_test_method: Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled paired t-test on per-fold differences vs. Clinical-only (25 identical folds, df=24, mean n_test/n_train=0.2500 for FVC regression, 0.2500 for patient-level rapid-decliner AUC)
fusion_comparison.hrct_branch_design: HRCT-only and Early Fusion predict change from Baseline_FVC (Delta_FVC = Target_FVC - Baseline_FVC) using in-fold 1st-99th percentile winsorization on HU/volume features, in-fold 15D ResNet-18 PCA, and strong L2 regularization (Ridge alpha=500). All reconstructed FVC predictions across all 6 methods are winsorized to the physiologically plausible range [500, 6500] mL.
fusion_comparison.selected_fusion_rule: Best mean CV Modified Laplace Log-Likelihood (nominal only unless paired Nadeau-Bengio 95% CI excludes zero)
fusion_comparison.selection_rationale: Late fusion (mean) has the best mean FVC Laplace LL (-6.7928 vs. clinical-only -6.8076; Δ = +0.0148, p = 0.1778, nominal only), while its rapid-decliner AUC is lower (0.5636 vs. 0.6343). Stacking (OOF meta-learner) is the only method with a statistically confirmed gain over clinical-only (+0.0104 Laplace LL, p = 0.0006; -1.7 mL MAE, p = 0.0003); across 20 paired comparisons, both p-values survive Bonferroni correction (α = 0.0025), but the gain is clinically negligible (0.07%, under 0.1% of mean FVC 2676.5 mL). Exploratory.

extractor_comparison.overall_verdict: Across completed alternative extractors (med3d, radimagenet, ctclip; 168 paired Nadeau-Bengio tests, Holm-Bonferroni α = 0.05), none achieved a statistically confirmed improvement over current ResNet-18. None achieved a Holm-corrected improvement over Clinical-only. Not run: resnet50_imagenet_control (Disabled by user toggle RUN_IMAGENET_RESNET50_CONTROL = False). The deployed model is not changed automatically. Exploratory.

limitations: Dimensionality equalization via PCA: All raw embedding vectors (512-D for ResNet-18, Med3D, and CT-CLIP; 2,048-D for RadImageNet and ImageNet ResNet-50) are compressed strictly inside each training fold to 15 PCA components (PCA(n_components=15, random_state=42)), which prevents overfitting on n = 175 patients but may discard fine-grained variance in higher-dimensional embeddings.

Modality-specific preprocessing differences: 3D volumetric backbones (Med3D resampled lung-masked volumes with z-scoring; CT-CLIP full-chest [-1000, 1000] HU volumes resampled to (1.5, 0.75, 0.75) mm and cropped/padded to 240x480x480) require different spatial and intensity preprocessing than 2D slice-wise models (lung-masked [-1000, 0] HU slices resized to 224x224 and mean-pooled).

Internal cross-validation only (not Kaggle leaderboard scores): All metrics come from 5-Repeat x 5-Fold patient-grouped internal cross-validation on n = 175 OSIC train.csv patients (1,359 future visits) and are not comparable to hidden Kaggle OSIC leaderboard scores.

Exploratory separate cohort without IPF labels: OSIC is an independent pulmonary fibrosis cohort with no IPF vs. Non-IPF diagnostic labels. Progression results are strictly exploratory and never alter the deployed Zenodo IPF diagnostic classifier or the deployed OSIC serving pipeline automatically.
Non-commercial weight restriction for CT-CLIP / CT-RATE: CT-CLIP and CT-RATE weights are gated under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial) and must never be redistributed inside handover packages.
